missing.why: Fate's Call knocks up enemies where her bound ally lands. It's the ally landing but Kalista's ability; a data question (knock-up label) for the maintainer.
GNAR! sends enemies flying into walls, but it's a knock-back. Rule-correct out.

disputable.why: Apprehend's text says it Knocks Up, but every player thinks of it as a pull.
Dragon's Rage knocks the target back; only enemies it collides with are knocked up.
The knock-up comes from Daisy's third attack, not Ivern himself.
Only the uncharged Keeper's Verdict knocks up; the charged one knocks back.
Her passive only keeps an already knocked-up enemy airborne; the maintainer counts that as knocking up.

wording.why: Players treat any airborne effect (knock-backs, Lee Sin's kick, Gnar's ult) as a knock-up; the Rule excludes knock-backs.
wording.suggestion: Name a champion who can knock an enemy up into the air

fun.why: Yasuo and Malphite come instantly and most players can name several, but 44 answers spread across every role mean nobody names them all.

champion:Yasuo.why: Knock-ups are his whole kit (Last Breath); the textbook answer.

champion:Malphite.why: Unstoppable Force is the iconic knock-up ult.

champion:Alistar.why: Pulverize is the classic support knock-up.

champion:JarvanIV.why: The E-Q combo knock-up is well known.

champion:Janna.why: Howling Gale is a famous knock-up.

champion:Nami.why: Aqua Prison and Tidal Wave both knock up.

champion:Vi.why: Assault and Battery is a memorable knock-up.

champion:MonkeyKing.why: Cyclone is a famous teamfight knock-up.

champion:Nautilus.why: Passive and Depth Charge knock-ups are known.

champion:Riven.why: Q3 knock-up is known to top laners.

champion:Gragas.why: Body Slam is remembered as a knock-up by some, a stun by others.

champion:LeeSin.why: Players think of the kick as a knock-up.

champion:Sejuani.why: Arctic Assault knock-up is known to junglers.

champion:Ornn.why: Call of the Forge God knock-up is known.

champion:Taliyah.why: Seismic Shove; Taliyah is less played.

champion:Rammus.why: Players remember the taunt, not the Soaring Slam knock-up.

champion:Rell.why: Ferromancy knock-up; Rell is less played.

champion:Fizz.why: Players remember the shark but not as a knock-up.

champion:Lulu.why: Wild Growth's knock-up is overshadowed by the size boost.

champion:Velkoz.why: Tectonic Disruption knock-up; mid mains get it.

champion:Braum.why: Glacial Fissure knock-up is easy to forget.

champion:Neeko.why: Pop Blossom; players remember the stun.

champion:RekSai.why: Unburrow knock-up is known to junglers only.

champion:Singed.why: Fling is remembered as a throw.

champion:Sylas.why: Abscond's knock-up is easy to forget.

champion:Aatrox.why: The Q edge knock-up is a detail.

champion:Belveth.why: Royal Maelstrom knock-up is little known.

champion:Poppy.why: Players think of the ult as a knock-back.

champion:TahmKench.why: Abyssal Dive knock-up is rarely recalled.

champion:Darius.why: Players remember Apprehend as a pull.

champion:Ivern.why: Daisy's knock-up is a deep cut.

champion:Zaahen.why: New champion; few players know his kit.
